activities.title: Juicy Jay's at Legion Brewing
activities.description: Settle onto the balcony at this neighborhood brewery for a pint of their famous hazy IPA. It’s a quintessential Plaza Midwood hangout for locals who value high-energy social scenes.

activities.title: Rooftop Views at Wooden Robot
activities.description: Enjoy a Good Morning Vietnam coffee vanilla cream ale while overlooking the South End skyline. This brewery is a staple for its inclusive atmosphere and prime Rail Trail real estate.

activities.title: Tapas at Barcelona Wine Bar
activities.description: Experience the high-energy, Mediterranean vibes of this bustling South End wine bar. It is a premier social baseline for sharing small plates and heavy pours on a lively patio.

activities.title: IPAs at Heist Brewery
activities.description: Head to this converted industrial space for award-winning IPAs and a full kitchen menu. It’s a staple for NoDa socialites who appreciate a gritty but polished brewery experience.

activities.title: Gas Station Social at 1501 South Mint
activities.description: Lounge at this converted 1930s gas station that has become a premier social hub for the city’s diverse and queer communities. The outdoor patio is the place to be for Sunday Funday or a high-vibe evening.

activities.title: Fusion Bites at The Cowfish
activities.description: Brave the crowds for the legendary 'Burgushi' in a vibrant, high-energy atmosphere that has been a city staple for over a decade. It is a loud, fun, and adventurous culinary crossroads.
activities.location: The Cowfish Sushi Burger Bar, SouthPark

activities.title: Literary Walk at The Green
activities.description: Wander through this whimsical, 1.5-acre urban park dedicated to literature, featuring sculptures and water features. It is a serene but culturally rich baseline for an afternoon stroll through Uptown.

activities.title: Patio Tacos at RuRu's Tacos & Tequila
activities.description: Mingle on one of the city's most beautiful historic patios with a margarita in hand. This Myers Park favorite is a high-visibility social hub for the young professional and creative crowd.

activities.title: Bikes & BBQ at Mac's Speed Shop
activities.description: Lean into the gritty, high-energy vibe of this South End institution known for its massive patio and extensive beer list. It is a quintessential social crossroads for bikers, locals, and visitors.

activities.title: Light Rail Brews at Triple C
activities.description: Sip award-winning beers in this sprawling South End warehouse featuring a high-energy taproom and outdoor space. It is a foundational social spot for the neighborhood’s craft beer enthusiasts.
activities.location: Triple C Brewing Co, South End

activities.title: Belgian Brews at Sugar Creek
activities.description: Explore Belgian-inspired ales in a massive, nautical-themed brewery within the LoSo district. Its social energy and adventurous beer styles make it an essential staple of the local craft scene.

activities.title: Kombucha & Pints at Lenny Boy
activities.description: Visit this diverse taproom known for its organic kombucha, traditional beers, and high-energy social events. It’s an inclusive, wellness-adjacent social baseline for the South End community.
activities.location: Lenny Boy Brewing Co, South End

activities.title: Nature Escape at USNWC
activities.description: Hike the extensive trail system along the river to reset your mental state away from the urban bustle. The natural terrain offers a rugged adventure that showcases the city's access to true wilderness.

activities.title: Market Exploration at Optimist Hall
activities.description: Navigate this massive, transformed textile mill for an early-morning bite from local artisan vendors. It is a sensory-heavy market experience that perfectly showcases the city's culinary and cultural diversity.

activities.title: Morning Run at Freedom Park
activities.description: Jog around the lake at Charlotte's signature urban park before the workday starts. It’s the foundational fitness baseline for the local community, offering scenic views and a highly social atmosphere.

activities.title: Vietnamese Soul at LangVan
activities.description: Experience legendary hospitality at a city staple beloved by the queer community for decades. This essential culinary baseline features a massive menu where the owner treats every regular like family.

activities.title: Art Immersion at Mint Museum Uptown
activities.description: Explore world-class craft, design, and contemporary art in a sleek, architectural gem. It is a sophisticated baseline for an artsy afternoon in the heart of Charlotte's cultural district.

activities.title: Pints at Olde Mecklenburg Brewery
activities.description: Visit the OG Charlotte biergarten for an authentic German-style experience in LoSo. Its massive outdoor space is the city's premier social anchor for weekend brews and bratwurst.

activities.title: Historic Steaks at Beef 'N Bottle
activities.description: Step back in time at this legendary, low-lit steakhouse that has maintained its classic mid-century charm since 1958. It is a foundational, unpretentious piece of Charlotte’s culinary soul.

activities.title: South End Rail Trail Social
activities.description: Walk the three-mile urban vein that defines modern Charlotte social life. It is the city's premier high-visibility corridor for a social stroll, offering endless people-watching and spontaneous entries into local bars.
activities.location: South End Rail Trail, South End

activities.title: Kings Drive Art Walk
activities.description: Stroll along the Little Sugar Creek Greenway and explore a vibrant outdoor art festival featuring fine and emerging artists. Admission is free, offering a chance to discover unique handcrafted works and enjoy the spring weather. Vendors will have items available for purchase.

activities.title: Free Comic Book Day
activities.description: Visit participating local comic book stores to pick up free comic books and celebrate the art of storytelling. It's a great opportunity to discover new series or revisit old favorites, perfect for fans and newcomers alike. Check local shops for specific hours and offerings.

activities.title: Free Museum Admission (BofA/Merrill)
activities.description: Bank of America and Merrill Lynch cardholders can enjoy free general admission to various participating museums across Charlotte. This is part of the 'Museums on Us' program, offering a fantastic cultural outing. Check the Bank of America website for a list of eligible museums.

activities.title: Bowl Street Pop-Up Market
activities.description: Discover local artisans, makers, and small businesses at this monthly pop-up market on the green at The Bowl. Enjoy unique handmade goods, food trucks, and support the local community. Admission is free.

activities.title: Charlotte NColor Festival
activities.description: Celebrate Black history, culture, and storytelling at the Charlotte NColor Festival, part of a statewide project. Expect art, games, music, and cultural activations in an immersive experience. Passes are pay-what-you-can to ensure accessibility.

activities.title: Music Bingo at Primal Brewery
activities.description: Test your musical knowledge and enjoy a fun night of Music Bingo at Primal Brewery. It's a lively atmosphere perfect for unwinding with friends and enjoying some local brews. Participation is free.

activities.title: Free Public Tour of Innovation Barn
activities.description: Take a free guided tour of the Innovation Barn, a hub for circular economy initiatives in Charlotte. Learn about sustainable practices, recycling, and innovative solutions for waste reduction. It's an insightful and educational experience.

activities.title: Lattes & Locals Market
activities.description: Start your Sunday morning with coffee and community at the Lattes & Locals Market, a weekly pop-up at Night Swim Roastery and Cafe. Browse local artisan goods and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere.
activities.location: Night Swim Roastery and Cafe, Charlotte

activities.title: Charlotte Transportation History Bike Tour
activities.description: See Charlotte in a new way with a free guided bike tour exploring important spots in the city's transportation history. It's an engaging and active way to learn about Charlotte's past. The tour starts Uptown.

activities.title: Christian Cardio Dance Class
activities.description: Join an energetic Christian Cardio Dance Class to get your body moving and spirit grooving. No dance experience is required, just bring your enthusiasm for a fun workout in a supportive community. There's an option to donate to offset studio costs.

activities.title: Teal Diva 5K
activities.description: Participate in the 12th Annual Teal Diva 5K, celebrating over a decade of supporting women affected by gynecologic cancer. This inclusive run/walk welcomes all backgrounds to honor strong women and raise awareness. Registration fee applies.

activities.title: AAPI 5K - Charlotte
activities.description: Join the AAPI 5K in Charlotte, a community event promoting health and wellness while celebrating Asian American and Pacific Islander heritage. It's a great way to get active and support a meaningful cause. Registration fee applies.

activities.title: SportsLink Field Day 2026
activities.description: Relive your schoolyard days at this adult outdoor field day event, where coed teams compete in silly games. Expect activities like Belly Bumpers and Tug of War, plus music, food, and drinks from VBGB. Grab your friends for a fun, active afternoon.

activities.title: Buff Faye's Drag Brunch: Slay & Sashay
activities.description: Experience Charlotte's #1 Best Drag Brunch with Buff Faye and her fabulous divas for a 'Slay & Sashay' themed show. Enjoy high-energy performances, delicious food, and a lively atmosphere. Tickets are for the show only; food and drinks are separate.

activities.title: The Charlotte Margarita Festival
activities.description: Sip, savor, and spice things up at The Charlotte Margarita Festival, a Cinco de Mayo weekend fiesta. Hop between South End's best bars for exclusive taco and margarita specials, DJs, and themed photo ops. General Admission tickets are available.

activities.title: DRAGO Charities Drag Brunch
activities.description: Enjoy a fabulous Charity Drag Brunch featuring fierce performances and delicious food, all while supporting local causes like the Gay Men's Chorus of Charlotte. Expect high-energy numbers and interactive moments for a fun and impactful afternoon. Tickets are for the show only.

activities.title: Charlotte Singles Event: Trivia Night (Ages 25-40)
activities.description: Meet other singles aged 25-40 at a fun trivia night designed to spark conversations and connections. Enjoy drinks, custom icebreakers, and multiple rounds of questions at Pilot Brewing. It's a unique way to socialize and potentially meet someone new.

activities.title: Trym (18+) Concert
activities.description: Catch an early morning electronic music set by Trym at the Blackbox Theater. This 18+ event offers a unique start to your Saturday with cutting-edge sounds. Tickets are available from $20.

activities.title: Buff Faye's Drag Brunch: Hot & Ready
activities.description: Join Buff Faye and her divas for another spectacular drag brunch, this time with a 'Hot & Ready' theme. Enjoy fierce performances and a lively atmosphere, voted #1 Best Drag Brunch in Charlotte. Tickets are for the show only.

activities.title: Rock 'n' Reel Student Album Movie Premiere
activities.description: Attend the Rock 'n' Reel Student Album Movie Premiere, showcasing the creative work of students exploring music and film. This 'pay-what-you-want' event offers an accessible way to support emerging talent.

activities.title: 2 Pauls, 1 Show Comedy
activities.description: Laugh out loud at '2 Pauls, 1 Show' at The Comedy Club at Duckworth's. This comedy performance is part of the wider BOOM Charlotte Festival, offering individual show tickets for a night of humor.
activities.location: The Comedy Club at Duckworth's, Uptown

activities.title: The Nude Party Concert
activities.description: Catch The Nude Party live at the Neighborhood Theatre Main Room for a night of rock and roll. Known for their energetic performances, this is a great opportunity to see a rising band in an intimate venue. Estimated ticket price.

activities.title: Hippie Festival at Dallas Lavender Lane
activities.description: Take a short drive for a unique Hippie Festival experience at Dallas Lavender Lane Farm. Enjoy a day of peace, love, and good vibes with various activities and vendors. The price is per carload, making it a very affordable outing.
activities.location: Dallas Lavender Lane Farm, Dallas (near Charlotte)

activities.title: Charlotte' NColor Festival
activities.description: Immerse yourself in Black history and culture at this vibrant festival. Expect art, games, music, and cultural activations celebrating Black excellence, with a focus on storytelling and community. Passes are pay-what-you-can, ensuring accessibility for all.

activities.title: Charlotte - Tacos & Margs Crawl®
activities.description: Join the ultimate taco and margarita fiesta taking over South End's best bars. Expect packed patios, DJs, themed photo ops, and exclusive specials. General Admission gets you entry to 5+ venues with specials.

activities.title: Free Throw - Moments Before The Wind Tour
activities.description: Catch the 'Moments Before The Wind Tour' featuring Free Throw live at The Underground. This is a chance to see the popular rock band in an intimate setting. Grab your tickets for a night of high-energy music.

activities.title: Julian Vaughn Smooth Jazz Bassist
activities.description: Experience an evening of smooth jazz with Billboard's #1 bassist, Julian Vaughn, at Middle C Jazz. Enjoy soulful melodies and intricate bass lines in a sophisticated club atmosphere. Baby Grand Member tickets offer a discounted rate.

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Festival - Individual Show
activities.description: Dive into the diverse arts scene with an individual show at the BOOM Charlotte Festival. This artist-led festival champions creative risk-taking across theater, dance, music, poetry, and visual arts. Check the schedule for specific performances.

activities.title: Sabor & Slay International Sensations Drag Brunch
activities.description: Start your Saturday with a fabulous drag brunch hosted by The Vanity House. Enjoy delicious food, mimosas, and show-stopping performances by international drag sensations. It's a high-energy, queer-friendly way to kick off the weekend.

activities.title: RayBurger concert
activities.description: Catch RayBurger live at the PREMIER EVENT CENTER for a night of high-energy music and dancing. This artist is known for their dynamic stage presence and infectious beats, promising a memorable performance.

activities.title: WizTheMc concert
activities.description: See WizTheMc perform live at The Fillmore Charlotte. Known for his unique blend of genres and captivating lyrics, this concert offers a chance to experience a rising star in a popular music venue.
activities.location: The Fillmore Charlotte, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: 2 Pauls, 1 Show (Comedy)
activities.description: Enjoy an evening of stand-up comedy with '2 Pauls, 1 Show' at The Comedy Club at Duckworth's. This double-bill promises a night of laughter and sharp wit from two talented comedians.
activities.location: The Comedy Club at Duckworth's, Uptown

activities.title: Candlelight: Queen vs ABBA
activities.description: Experience a multi-sensory musical tribute to Queen and ABBA, surrounded by hundreds of candles. A string quartet will perform beloved hits from both legendary bands, creating a magical and nostalgic atmosphere.
activities.location: Historic Venue (e.g., The Great Hall), Uptown

activities.title: Candlelight: The Best of The Beatles
activities.description: Relive the iconic music of The Beatles in a unique candlelight concert. A string quartet will perform their most famous songs in a stunning venue, offering a beautiful and intimate way to celebrate the legendary band's legacy.
activities.location: Historic Venue (e.g., The Great Hall), Uptown

activities.title: October London & Lalah Hathaway Concert
activities.description: Experience a soulful evening with October London and Lalah Hathaway at Ovens Auditorium. This concert promises smooth vocals and timeless R&B, creating an unforgettable night of powerful performances and heartfelt lyrics.

activities.title: Steve Trevino Comedy Show
activities.description: Laugh out loud with 'America's Favorite Husband,' comedian Steve Trevino, at The Comedy Zone. His relatable approach and hilarious observations have made him a fast-rising star. This late show promises an evening of top-tier stand-up.
activities.location: Comedy Zone Charlotte, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: The Black Art Gala
activities.description: Attend the prestigious 'heard it through the grapevine' event for Charlotte's creative class. This sophisticated evening celebrates artisans and excellence across the Carolinas, offering a unique opportunity to connect with the city's vibrant art community.

activities.title: Lovin' Life Music Fest - VIP Day Pass
activities.description: Immerse yourself in the full festival experience with a VIP Day Pass to the Lovin' Life Music Fest. Enjoy premium access, exclusive viewing areas, and enhanced amenities to see top artists like Benson Boone, Teddy Swims, and Lola Young.

activities.title: Chef's Tasting Menu at The Fig Tree
activities.description: Indulge in an exquisite multi-course tasting menu at The Fig Tree, one of Charlotte's premier fine dining establishments. Experience innovative culinary creations paired with exceptional wines in an elegant, intimate setting. Perfect for a special occasion.

activities.title: Charlotte Symphony Orchestra - Pops Series
activities.description: Enjoy an evening of popular orchestral music with the Charlotte Symphony Orchestra's Pops Series. This performance features beloved classics and contemporary hits, offering a delightful and accessible classical music experience in a grand setting.

activities.title: The Kid LAROI - A Perfect World Tour
activities.description: Catch Australian singer and rapper The Kid LAROI on his 'A Perfect World Tour' at The Fillmore. Known for his catchy hooks and emotional breakup songs, this concert is sure to be a high-energy event.
activities.location: The Fillmore Charlotte, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: Sunday Jazz Brunch at The Ballantyne Hotel
activities.description: Indulge in a luxurious Sunday Jazz Brunch at the elegant Ballantyne Hotel. Enjoy an exquisite buffet spread, live jazz music, and impeccable service in a sophisticated setting. A perfect way to elevate your Sunday.

activities.title: Broadway at Blumenthal - Matinee Performance
activities.description: Experience the magic of Broadway with a matinee performance at the Blumenthal Performing Arts Center. Enjoy a world-class theatrical production, bringing the best of New York's stages to Charlotte. Check listings for the specific show.

activities.title: The Flamingo Revue Presents: Electric Flamingos
activities.description: Step into the dazzling world of burlesque with The Flamingo Revue's 'Electric Flamingos.' This show promises a night of captivating performances, elaborate costumes, and playful artistry. Expect an unforgettable and unique theatrical experience.

activities.title: Hot Wheels Legends Tour
activities.description: Witness custom car culture come alive at the Hot Wheels Legends Tour. Builders compete for a chance to have their custom car immortalized as a 1:64 scale Hot Wheels toy. It's a unique opportunity to see incredible automotive creations up close.

activities.title: James Hype concert
activities.description: Dance the night away with international DJ sensation James Hype at Trio Nightclub. Known for his high-energy sets and infectious beats, this is a prime opportunity to experience a top-tier electronic music performance in a vibrant club atmosphere.

activities.title: Cheers to the Cabaret
activities.description: Experience a unique cabaret performance at Huntersville United Methodist Church. This event offers an unexpected blend of entertainment and venue, promising an evening of diverse acts and a memorable atmosphere.

activities.title: Persistence, Patience & Prayer: A Walk for Peace
activities.description: Find your center and recharge your spirit with a meditative walk through the Almetto Howey Alexander Labyrinth. This free, well-kept secret among wellness insiders offers a unique way to find peace and reflection before the week begins.
activities.location: Almetto Howey Alexander Labyrinth, South Charlotte

activities.title: Adult Recess & Games Night
activities.description: Relive your childhood with an adults-only recess and games night at a local brewery. Expect giant Jenga, cornhole, board games, and maybe even some competitive dodgeball. It's a playful and social way to unwind with craft beers.

activities.title: Drag Bingo & Brunch
activities.description: Get ready for a wild Sunday with Drag Bingo & Brunch! Enjoy delicious food and drinks while fabulous drag queens host an outrageous game of bingo with hilarious commentary and performances. Expect prizes, laughter, and a lively atmosphere.

activities.title: Paranormal Walking Tour of Historic Charlotte
activities.description: Explore the darker side of Charlotte's history on a guided paranormal walking tour. Hear chilling tales of ghosts, unexplained phenomena, and haunted locations as you wander through the city's oldest streets. Not for the faint of heart!

activities.title: Silent Disco in Romare Bearden Park
activities.description: Dance under the stars at a Silent Disco in Romare Bearden Park. Grab a pair of headphones and choose from multiple DJ channels, creating your own personal dance party amidst a crowd of silent movers. It's a unique and liberating experience.

activities.title: Axe Throwing Tournament
activities.description: Test your aim and competitive spirit at an Axe Throwing Tournament. Join a league or simply compete for bragging rights in this surprisingly addictive and adrenaline-pumping activity. Safety instructions and coaching provided.

activities.title: Cult Film Midnight Screening
activities.description: Dive into the bizarre with a midnight screening of a cult classic film. Expect an enthusiastic audience, interactive elements, and a truly unique cinematic experience. Check listings for the specific, often obscure, title.
